case.presentation: 71 year old female with no significant past medical history presents with a single 9mm solid, spiculated nodule.
case.context: CT chest/abdomen/pelvis obtained preoperatively. No prior imaging.

ground_truth.notes: Maintainer-assigned high risk per Fleischner §'Risk Estimation' listing spiculated margins as a high-risk factor; oracle's smoking-only heuristic flags this never-smoker as low risk. Table 1A single solid >8mm is risk-invariant — both low and high route to CONSIDER_PET_OR_BIOPSY — so the disagreement is informative but doesn't change the recommendation.
